originalTitle: SIF AUM jumps 29% to Rs 17,858 crore in June; inflows surge 171% MoM
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified explanation of the news: Specialised Investment Funds, a type of investment fund, had a big increase in the amount of money they managed, growing by 29% to Rs 17,858 crore in June. This means more people put their money into these funds. The amount of new money coming into these funds also increased a lot, by 171%, compared to the previous month. This is a good sign for the investment industry, showing that many people are interested in investing, especially in certain types of funds like Hybrid Long-Short Funds. Overall, it seems like regular investors are continuing to put money into the stock market, with a record number of people setting up regular investment plans.

originalTitle: DMart Q1 results: Cons PAT up 11% to Rs 860 crore, revenue rises to Rs 18,795 crore
simplifiedContent: DMart, a retail company, just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year. The company made a profit of Rs 860 crore, which is 11% more than it made during the same time last year. Its revenue, or the amount of money it made from selling goods, increased by 14.9% to Rs 18,795 crore. This increase in profit and revenue is a positive sign for the company, and its EBITDA (a measure of its profitability) also grew by 15.4%. Overall, these results suggest that DMart had a strong quarter, which could be good news for investors who own its stock.

originalTitle: Nearly 60% of foreign inflows into India-focused funds withdrawn since 2024 peak: Report
simplifiedContent: Many foreign investors who had put their money into Indian stocks have taken it out - almost 60% of their investments have been withdrawn since 2024. The main reason for this is that they are now interested in investing in artificial intelligence opportunities around the world. In 2026, $9 billion was pulled out of Indian stock funds by these foreign investors. This is important because it can affect the Indian stock market and the overall economy. Foreign investors are instead putting their money into other areas, such as US stocks and gold funds, as well as European investments.

originalTitle: Nomura sees 22% upside in Ather Energy. Here's why it's the brokerage's top EV pick
simplifiedContent: Nomura, a company that helps people make investment decisions, thinks Ather Energy is a good investment and expects its stock price to increase by 22%. They believe this because the market for electric two-wheelers, like scooters and motorcycles, is likely to grow a lot. As a result, Nomura has increased its target price for Ather Energy to ₹1,470 and is recommending that people buy the stock. This makes Ather Energy Nomura's top choice for investing in electric vehicle companies. Nomura thinks Ather Energy will benefit from the trend of people switching to electric vehicles.

originalTitle: Why large cap and mid cap funds could be the best mutual fund to bet on now, according to Abakkus study
simplifiedContent: A recent study by Abakkus Mutual Fund found that large and mid-cap funds might be a good investment choice right now. This is because company earnings are getting better and the prices of these funds are reasonable. The stock market has recently gone down, which can be a good opportunity for long-term investors to get in. This means that the prices of stocks might start to match the growth in company earnings, making it a good time to invest. Overall, this study suggests that large and mid-cap funds could be a smart investment option for those looking to put their money in the stock market.

originalTitle: AI chip fever returns? SK Hynix  share price surges 13% after blockbuster $26.5 billion US listing
simplifiedContent: SK Hynix, a company that makes computer chips, had a very successful first day of trading on the US stock market, called Nasdaq. The company raised $26.5 billion, which is a lot of money, and its stock price went up 13%. This is notable because other similar companies in the semiconductor industry have been experiencing ups and downs lately. The strong interest in SK Hynix suggests that investors are excited about companies that make chips for artificial intelligence (AI) systems. This matters because it shows that investors think AI technology is important and are willing to invest in companies that support it.
